extracted.intended_audience: senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing NIH biographical sketches for grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing the NIH-format biographical sketch for senior/key personnel and other significant contributors, using the specified sections (Personal Statement, Positions and Honors, Contributions to Science, Research Support, Education/Training) and following the form constraints (page limit and required fields).

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical sketch format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The entire biosketch for each person must follow the provided format and must not exceed five pages. Ensure each section requested by the form is present and that content fits within the page limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use current OMB/eRA form version
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the currently approved NIH/eRA biographical sketch form/version (include OMB/form revision metadata where applicable) to ensure compliance with current instructions and page limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise narrative describing the individual's qualifications, current roles, relevance to the proposed project, mentoring responsibilities, and how the person's expertise will contribute to the project. The example demonstrates describing supervision, mentorship, and specific contributions to the candidate's proposed award.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Honors (including Positions and Employment)
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Positions and Employment; Other Experience and Professional Memberships; Honors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List positions and employment chronologically with dates and institutional affiliations. Include other relevant experience, professional memberships, committee roles, and honors/awards with dates. The page shows detailed chronological entries (e.g., 'Postgraduate Research Assistant, ... 1993-1996') and lists memberships and honors with years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training entries and fields
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each training entry provide Institution and Location, Degree (if applicable), Completion Date (MM/YYYY), and Field of Study. Start with baccalaureate and include subsequent relevant training (postdoc, residency). Modify rows as needed to reflect the individual's training history.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Contributions to Science
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide narrative descriptions of major scientific contributions (each contribution as a numbered item) and include representative publications for each contribution (examples labeled a., b., c., d.). Summarize the impact and context of the work and cite representative papers (typically multiple citations per contribution).

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Research Support (ongoing and completed)
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH SUPPORT — Ongoing Research Support (Selected) and Completed Research Support (Selected)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each grant or contract list the sponsor (e.g., NIH institute), grant number, title, brief description/aims of the project, role of the individual (e.g., PI, Co-Investigator, Subcontract PI), and performance dates. Distinguish ongoing versus completed support and include selected items that illustrate relevant experience. Example entries include grant number, concise aim statement, role, and date range.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide link to full bibliography when applicable
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete List of Published Work in MyBibliography: http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/myncbi/...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When the biosketch references a comprehensive publication list, provide the MyBibliography or other persistent URL to the full bibliography so reviewers can access the complete publication record beyond the representative citations included in Contributions to Science.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structure and labeling of sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the labeled sections (A. PERSONAL STATEMENT, B. Positions and Honors, C. CONTRIBUTION TO SCIENCE, D. RESEARCH SUPPORT, EDUCATION/TRAINING) as headings in the biosketch.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the specified section headings and ordering to organize the biosketch content exactly as the form shows. Under each heading, include the types of content exemplified (narrative personal statement; chronological positions; numbered contributions with citations; categorized research support).
